XMLDB.COMMENT: Reportium: reports, their drill-down levels and the roles that can see them

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the report belongs to (site id: site report)

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who created the report

FIELD.NAME: visible
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 shown, 0 hidden

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the report

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: Description shown above the report

FIELD.NAME: summaryformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Text format of the summary

FIELD.NAME: export
FIELD.COMMENT: Download formats offered (comma list of Moodle data formats)

FIELD.NAME: global
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: the report can run inside any course, with the data of that course

FIELD.NAME: displaytotalrecords
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: show the row count of each level

FIELD.NAME: displayprintbutton
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: offer the print button

FIELD.NAME: daterange
FIELD.COMMENT: Period shown first when the SQL uses %%STARTTIME%% / %%ENDTIME%% (date_range presets); empty = all time

FIELD.NAME: kpicards
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: KPI cards above the chart (levels may change it); off for new reports

FIELD.NAME: kpirows
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: a card with the number of rows

FIELD.NAME: totalsrow
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: totals row under the table

FIELD.NAME: views
FIELD.COMMENT: Chart types offered (comma list of bar, pie, line, table); empty = all

FIELD.NAME: template
FIELD.COMMENT: Key of the ready-made template this report was installed from (Reportium default); empty for reports made by users (Reportium custom)

TABLE.NAME: local_reportium_level
TABLE.COMMENT: Custom SQL queries per report and drill-down level

FIELD.NAME: drilllevel
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=root, 1=first drilldown, 2=second, etc.

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable label for this level

FIELD.NAME: config
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: chart mapping overrides (labelcolumn, valuecolumn, metrics, defaultview, title, sort, limit, stacked)

TABLE.NAME: local_reportium_role
TABLE.COMMENT: Roles allowed to view a report (empty = the report's default permissions)

TABLE.NAME: local_reportium_version
TABLE.COMMENT: Every saved version of the SQL of a level (history, restore, audit)

FIELD.NAME: drilllevel
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = level 1

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: saved, deleted or restored

TABLE.NAME: local_reportium_schedule
TABLE.COMMENT: Scheduled email delivery of a report view

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who created it: the report runs with this user's access

FIELD.NAME: recipients
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: users, cohorts, roles (ids) and emails

FIELD.NAME: frequency
FIELD.COMMENT: daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly

FIELD.NAME: weekday
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 Sunday .. 6 Saturday (weekly)

FIELD.NAME: monthday
FIELD.COMMENT: 1..28 (monthly, quarterly)

FIELD.NAME: hour
FIELD.COMMENT: 0..23, in the timezone of the creator

FIELD.NAME: format
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle data format

FIELD.NAME: viewstate
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: level, path, search, filters, sort of the view sent

FIELD.NAME: daterange
FIELD.COMMENT: Period of the data (date_range presets, relative to the sending time)

FIELD.NAME: sendcondition
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: when to send (empty = always): {type: rows} or {type: value, column, agg, op, value}

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: sent, empty or error
